title: Middleware Manager
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


The Manager, Middleware Services team is responsible for leading the strategy, engineering, operations, automation, security, and modernization of enterprise middleware and container platforms. This role manages a team of engineers responsible for delivering highly available, secure, and scalable platform services that support critical business applications across traditional infrastructure and AWS cloud environments.  

  

The successful candidate will balance people leadership, platform ownership, operational excellence, and technology modernization while partnering with application teams, architecture, infrastructure, security, and cloud engineering organizations. The role is expected to drive adoption of cloud\-native technologies, automation, self\-service capabilities, and engineering best practices that improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Platform Ownership \& Strategy**

* Own the enterprise middleware and container platform portfolio, including web servers, application servers, Kubernetes platforms, container images, and supporting infrastructure.
* Define and execute platform roadmaps aligned to cloud modernization and enterprise technology strategies.
* Ensure platform reliability, resiliency, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Drive technology currency through lifecycle management, patching, upgrades, and decommissioning of legacy technologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience through self\-service capabilities, automation, and platform engineering practices.

### **Cloud \& Platform Engineering**

* Lead engineering and operational support for enterprise Kubernetes and AWS EKS platforms.
* Drive modernization initiatives, including migration of traditional middleware\-hosted applications to cloud\-native platforms.
* Establish standardized deployment patterns, container images, CI/CD pipelines, and operational practices.
* Manage Kubernetes cluster lifecycle activities including upgrades, capacity planning, security remediation, and platform observability.
* Partner with application teams to onboard workloads onto cloud platforms while ensuring operational readiness and supportability.

### **Middleware Services Management**

* Provide leadership for enterprise middleware technologies including: Apache HTTP Server Apache Tomcat Microsoft IIS IBM WebSphere Application Server Red Hat JBoss (preferred)
* Establish standards for platform configuration, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Ensure middleware environments remain secure, stable, and compliant with enterprise standards.

### **DevOps, Automation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Drive automation initiatives using infrastructure and platform engineering tools.
* Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support application and platform deployments.
* Promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management practices.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation, self\-healing capabilities, and reduction of manual processes.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, customer satisfaction, and cost optimization.

### **Service Reliability \& Operations**

* Ensure operational support for middleware and cloud platforms.
* Accountable for incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
* Lead major incident response, root cause analysis, and implementation of permanent corrective actions.
* Establish service\-level objectives (SLOs), operational metrics, and performance indicators.
* Drive improvements in platform availability, recovery capabilities, and operational maturity.

### **Security, Risk \& Compliance**

* Ensure platforms adhere to enterprise security, risk, and compliance requirements.
* Lead vulnerability remediation and security patching programs.
* Partner with cybersecurity teams to implement security controls and tooling.
* Maintain audit readiness and governance for supported platforms.
* Ensure compliance with organizational standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.

### **People Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing engineering team.
* Drive organizational capability building through training, certification, and career development initiatives.
* Conduct performance management, talent reviews, hiring, succession planning, and employee engagement activities.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

### **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Serve as the primary escalation point for middleware and cloud platform services.
* Build strong partnerships with application development, architecture, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams.
* Communicate platform health, risks, modernization initiatives, and strategic priorities to senior leadership.
* Manage vendor relationships and ensure delivery against service commitments and operational expectations.

### **Financial \& Capacity Management**

* Manage platform budgets, software licensing, and infrastructure consumption.
* Drive cloud and infrastructure cost optimization initiatives.
* Forecast platform growth and capacity requirements.
* Ensure efficient utilization of platform and infrastructure resources.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 8\+ years of experience supporting enterprise middleware and infrastructure platforms.
* 4\+ years of leadership experience managing technology teams.
* Strong expertise in enterprise middleware technologies and cloud\-native platforms.
* Experience leading large\-scale operational support and modernization initiatives.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

### **Middleware Platforms**

* Apache HTTP Server
* Apache Tomcat
* Microsoft IIS
* IBM WebSphere Application Server
* Red Hat JBoss

### **Container \& Cloud Platforms**

* Kubernetes
* Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)

### **DevOps \& Automation**

### **Cloud Technologies**

We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. title: Slate/Lead squared/Meritto - Administrator
description:
ApplyBoard simplifies the study abroad application process by connecting international students, international student advisors, and educational institutions on one personalized platform. For more than a decade, ApplyBoard's team members have been dedicated to breaking down barriers to international education, while thriving at a company that invests in their career growth. Our six core values guide us in our mission to educate the world, and are the foundation of our company culture. As an organization built on diversity, our team members are representative of the students we support.

 **The Opportunity:**


We are hiring a Slate Administrator who will be accountable for configuration, data integrity, integrations, communications delivery, security, and the day to day operational health of the platform that carries every prospective student from first inquiry through enrollment.


This is a technical position. The incumbent writes queries, builds source formats, maintains the Slate rules engine, and owns the integration between Slate and Ellucian Colleague. The position has no direct reports.

 **What You’ll Be Doing Every Day:**

**Platform Configuration and Ownership**

* Configure and maintain Slate application forms, events, portals, decision letters, materials, checklists, and status workflows.
* Build and maintain the Slate rules engine, including population rules, field maintenance rules, and workflow automation.
* Administer Slate Reader, including bins, review steps, scoring, and committee workflow for application review.
* Administer datasets, prompts, custom fields, and configurable joins, and enforce a documented field governance standard so the schema remains supportable.
* Manage sandbox and test instances, release testing, and controlled promotion of configuration changes to production.
* Evaluate Technolutions quarterly releases and recommend adoption of capabilities that reduce institutional effort.

 **Data, Integration, and Reporting**

* Own the bidirectional integration between Slate and Ellucian Colleague, including student record creation, program and term mapping, and financial aid touchpoints.
* Build and maintain source formats and inbound feeds, including Common App, test scores, transcript services, search names, National Student Clearinghouse, and international partner files.
* Author and maintain queries, exports, and scheduled jobs supporting daily operations and executive reporting.
* Own record matching, deduplication, and merge logic, and maintain the documented data dictionary and funnel stage definitions.
* Produce funnel and yield reporting that reconciles to the student information system, and resolve discrepancies before they reach Cabinet or Board reporting.
* Partner with the data and analytics team so that Slate data lands correctly in the University reporting environment.

 **Communications Delivery**

* Administer Slate Deliver for email and text messaging, including templates, campaigns, deliverability, authentication records, suppression lists, and bounce management.
* Execute and maintain the migration of student text messaging to Slate Deliver, including opt in records, consent history, and number provisioning.
* Maintain compliance with CAN\-SPAM, TCPA, and University communication governance standards.
* Enforce message frequency and audience governance so that students are not over contacted across communication platforms.

 **Security, Compliance, and Governance**

* Administer role based permissions on a least privilege basis, and execute quarterly access reviews and same day offboarding.
* Maintain FERPA compliance in all configuration, reporting, and third party data sharing.
* Maintain configuration documentation, change logs, and recovery procedures for the platform.
* Support information security review of new Slate integrations, connectors, and vendor data exchanges.

 **Support, Training, and Project Delivery**

* Serve as tier 2 and tier 3 support for Slate users across Admissions, Enrollment, Financial Aid, and Athletics.
* Develop and deliver training and written documentation for functional users so that platform capability is not concentrated in a single person.
* Contribute to project delivery for CRM consolidation, platform retirement, and downstream integration work.
* Participate in the Slate user community and applicable professional development.
* Perform other job related duties as assigned.

 **What You Bring to the Table:**


The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the essential functions of this position.

 **Knowledge:**

* Bachelor’s degree, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
* Two or more years of hands\-on Slate administration or configuration experience in a higher education setting.
* Working knowledge of Slate Rules, Source Formats, Configurable Joins, Deliver, and Reader.
* Knowledge of admissions and enrollment funnel operations, including application review, decision release, and yield activity.
* Knowledge of FERPA, CAN\-SPAM, and TCPA as they apply to student records and student communication.
* Knowledge of student information system data structures. Ellucian Colleague experience preferred.
* Technolutions Slate certification or documented Slate Summit training preferred.
* Experience migrating from Salesforce or another CRM platform to Slate preferred.

**Skills:**

* Query writing skill in SQL or Slate query logic, including subqueries, joins, and exports, performed independently and without vendor assistance.
* Configuration skill across a CRM platform, including forms, workflow automation, and permission structures.
* Integration skill, including file based feeds, scheduled jobs, and web service connections between systems.
* Technical writing skill sufficient to produce documentation that another administrator can follow.
* Working skill with XML, XSLT, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as used in Slate portals and Deliver templates, preferred.
* Scripting skill in Python or a comparable language for data preparation, preferred.
* Troubleshooting skill sufficient to isolate a defect between the CRM, the integration layer, and the student information system.

 **Abilities:**

* Ability to translate a functional request into a supportable technical configuration, and to decline configuration that will not scale.
* Ability to treat platform health as a personal accountability rather than a queue of tickets.
* Ability to reconcile reported figures to the source system, and to withhold any figure that cannot be substantiated.
* Ability to work to deadline during peak application, decision release, and term start cycles, including occasional evening and weekend hours.
* Ability to partner effectively with admissions counselors, enrollment leadership, and technical staff.
* Ability to maintain the confidentiality of student records at all times.

**About ApplyBoard**


ApplyBoard empowers students around the world to access international education. Our global team leverages cutting\-edge technology to build innovative tools and share sector insights that support our network of international students and 1,500\+ partner institutions. We've helped more than 1,300,000 students from over 180 countries with their study abroad journey so far, and we're just getting started.


Ready to join us? We're grateful for your interest in joining the ApplyBoard team. However, only select applicants will be contacted for an interview.


We may use artificial intelligence tools to support the hiring process, potentially while reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing applicant responses. These tools don't replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by our team members. If you'd like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.


ApplyBoard welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates in all aspects of the hiring and selection process.

title: Sr. Analyst I - ServiceNow Administrator
description:
**A Day in Your Life at MKS:**


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior ServiceNow Engineer to join our ServiceNow Team and help drive the evolution of the ServiceNow platform at MKS. As a ServiceNow Engineer, you will design, build, and enhance solutions across ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HAM, SAM, and Employee Center. You’ll partner closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical designs and deliver high quality solutions that improve user experience, automate operations, and strengthen platform maturity.


This position requires a blend of hands\-on development, platform engineering, and business analysis skills. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle from discovery and design through deployment, while helping shape the future of how our organization uses ServiceNow.

 **You Will Make an Impact By:**

**Solution Design \& Development**

* Participate in the full lifecycle of ServiceNow delivery from requirements and design through build, test, and deployment
* Design and implement customized workflows, automation, UI policies, business rules, client scripts, Script Includes, and integrations
* Configure and enhance core modules (ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HAM, SAM) as needed
* Develop and maintain integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and other secure integration frameworks
* Ensure designs align with enterprise architecture, coding standards, and ServiceNow best practices

**Business Analysis \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with product owners, process owners, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into user stories and technical specifications
* Facilitate workshops and discovery sessions to understand current\-state processes and identify opportunities for improvement
* Define acceptance criteria and support UAT planning, execution, and defect resolution
* Serve as a subject\-matter expert on ServiceNow capabilities, advising customers on the best way to solve business challenges

**Platform Operations \& Continuous Improvement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support, troubleshoot complex issues, and perform root\-cause analysis
* Support platform upgrades, patching, release cycles, and instance management processes
* Identify automation opportunities, streamline workflows, and help reduce manual effort and technical debt
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, process guides, and design specifications

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise\-scale ServiceNow solutions
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Glide API, and server/client\-side scripting across the platform
* Experience implementing and customizing modules such as Incident, Problem, Change, CMDB, Request, Knowledge, discovery/CMDB integrations, and automation flows
* Hands\-on experience integrating ServiceNow with third\-party systems via REST, SOAP, Web Services, MID Server, and IntegrationHub
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical audiences

**Preferred Skills:**

* ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CIS\-ITSM, CIS\-ITOM, CIS\-SPM, CAD, or others
* Experience with Discovery, Service Mapping, Performance Analytics, Orchestration, or Security Incident Response
* Familiarity with Service Portal, UI Builder, Workspace, or Flow Designer advanced functionality
* Experience acting as a Business Analyst or Product Owner in addition to technical responsibilities

title: Brand Manager - Ostocalcium

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Brand Manager – Ostocalcium role will deliver sustainable business growth by shaping brand strategy, identifying consumer and category opportunities, leading innovation and communication plans, and ensuring effective commercialization across channels and markets

* Deliver topline, P\&L and full year plans for the brand.

* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies and activations to drive brand growth and market share gains.
* Create and execute innovative, consumer\-centric marketing campaigns across multiple channels (digital, traditional, in\-store, Dcomm etc).
* Drive product positioning, ensuring alignment with consumer needs, market trends, and company objectives.
* Performance management \& Budgeting\- Plan, execute, and optimize marketing campaigns, ensuring alignment with budget and objectives. Track campaign performance, analyze results, and adjust strategies for optimal ROI.
* Influence senior cross\-functional stakeholders to align commercial, category, sales, and marketing priorities.
* Provide strategic direction to agencies and internal teams to ensure consistent brand positioning.
* Cross functional collaboration and Agency Management.

**Why you?**

**Basic Qualifications:**

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:


* MBA/masters from an institute of repute.
* Minimum 4 years of total experience, with 2\+ years in brand management.
* Strong stakeholder management and leadership skills.
* Proven experience in developing and executing brand strategies and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of consumer insights, market research, brand equity, and portfolio management.
* Experience managing cross\-functional stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Insights, and R\&D.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:


* Experience in FMCG or consumer healthcare sector.
* Demonstrated track record of driving business growth, market share gains, or successful innovation launches.
* Experience leading agencies and mentoring junior brand marketers.

Strong strategic thinking, influencing skills, and ability to operate in a fast\-paced, matrix organization.  

*

2026\-10\-17

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Track record of delivering IT Service Management (ITIL) infrastructure projects within a technically complex and dynamic environment, specifically that required to support multiple business.


* In Systems Management at Kyndryl, you will be critical in ensuring the smooth operation of our customers’ IT infrastructure.
* You'll be the mastermind behind maintaining and optimizing their systems, ensuring they're always running at peak performance.
* Coordinate and collaborate with cross\-functional teams, vendors, and third\-party suppliers.
* Ensure delivered solutions are realized in committed time frame and meet client expectation
* Establish a quality management system: tracking of project milestones, quality and KPIs
* Manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, implementing effective mitigation strategies.
* Monitor customer infrastructure and act as first point of contact for any alerts registered on the monitoring tool.
* Proven experience as a Service Delivery Manager, specifically in managing infrastructure projects within or similar large\-scale enterprise environments.
* Train and mentor other team members
* Participate in daily Operations meetings.
* Experience of managing business change
* Hands\-on experience on tools such as SCRUM, service snow JIRA, Trello, Microsoft tools is an advantage

Your future at Kyndryl


Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

* At least 7\+ years of experience in a similar role, preferably in an IT or technical setting.
* Should have knowledge of ITSM processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical information to non\-technical individuals.
* Fluent in Japanese (JLPT, N2 or above) and English, both written and verbal.
* Experience in working with Japanese clients or in a multicultural team is preferred.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Experience with IT service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).

**Preferred Professional Experience** :


* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical information to non\-technical individuals. Excellent in Japanese skills both translation and interpretation including Japanese Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) level should be N1/N2\.
* Experience in working with Japanese clients or in a multicultural team is preferred.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
Keen on personal and professional development.  
* 

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Distributed Application Support
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


In this role the person will be the responsible for ensuring success of business critical application operations by supporting the day to day batch processing, analyzing and fixing the issues on priority while adhering to standards and SLA's. The person should be able to support High priority(P1/P2\) incidents dynamically by providing timely resolution for the problem and handle other service requests. The person will also be responsible for handling minor enhancements, perform code reviews, handle application outages(planned/unplanned) and responsible for performance and maintenance of the highly critical business application. For this role we are looking for a highly motivated Individual who will be working as Sr. operations analysts working in technologies. The person should exhibit leadership qualities and demonstrate business acumen while working closely with business users to understand requirements and help team translate it into technical changes.  

Provide end to end production support and derive immediate resolutions/root\-cause of the incidents arising in and around the Legal, Compliance and Supervision Application’s Distributed systems to ensure quick restoration of service degradation and hence minimal business impact.**Key Responsibilities**

* Work as part of Operations team primarily supporting the Distributed applications
* Respond to incidents as well as work to identify proactive incident circumvention
* Support the Batch Operations that occurs nightly for Distributed systems
* Work on rotation basis during the day and night Operations shift to support both night batches and the day time Operations work alternatively
* Identify and recommend performance enhancements/improvements for applications
* Provide 24x7 on\-call support and work during hours that accommodate a portion of the US work day or during the full US work day shift (India night shift) including weekends / holidays


Incident \& Problem Management

* Work towards quick resolution/recovery of the high priority incidents in a time\-bound manner to ensure business continuity and minimum downtimes
* Coordinate and drive restoration of service disruptions/business escalated issues to meet and exceed established SLAs/OLAs
* Ensure action plans are in place to address recurring issues, including escalation and effective hand\-off to other teams as required
* Work towards aggressive root cause analysis/permanent resolution for all the business impacting recurring technical issues


Change Management

* Participate in change reviews and understand operational impacts due to changes
* Continuous Service Improvement Initiatives
* Improve effectiveness and efficiency of existing processes
* Follow best practices to enhance service delivery
* Develop the ability to think and act strategically
* Engage in the business and technology interactions to improve the service quality
* Ensure appropriate quality checks to decrease the risks and errors
* Ensure to execute processes to optimize cost and quality

  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 4\-8 years of experience in Production Support, Application Operations, Cloud Operations, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles.
* Strong experience supporting distributed applications in Production environments.
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting applications hosted in AWS Cloud environments including EC2, S3, Lambda, SNS, SQS, RDS and CloudWatch.
* Strong experience with: SQL and database troubleshooting Windows Server and Linux administration Java and/or .NET application support Enterprise batch scheduling platforms such as TWS (IBM Workload Scheduler), Tidal, Control\-M or equivalent
* Practical scripting experience with Bash Shell and PowerShell for production support, troubleshooting, operational automation, monitoring and batch processing.
* Experience automating manual operational tasks using PowerShell, Bash, Python or AWS native automation services.
* Experience supporting ETL workflows, data pipelines, file transfers and batch processing environments.
* Experience using monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Sumo Logic, CloudWatch or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices including Incident, Problem and Change Management.
* Proven experience in root cause analysis, service restoration and proactive incident prevention.

 **Preferred Qualifications**  

Candidates who have used following tools (or have familiarity with below) will have added advantage:•

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator Associate (Highly Preferred)
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (Optional)
* ITIL Foundation Certification
* Experience supporting financial services, compliance, supervision, legal, or highly regulated applications.
* Experience with: AWS Cloud Operations DevOps and CI/CD concepts Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) Python automation development
* Knowledge of ETL platforms such as Informatica, AWS Glue, IDMC, or equivalent.
* Experience building operational dashboards, monitoring solutions, and automated alerting mechanisms.
* Knowledge of Mainframe environments and scheduling integrations is a plus.
* Proven track record of identifying automation opportunities and reducing operational overhead through scripting and process improvements.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive operational mindset

**In\-Office Collaboration**

* We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. Some roles may require additional in\-office time or different in\-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

**Full\-Time/Part\-Time**


Full time**Timings**

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, genetic information, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, military status, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, family status or any other basis prohibited by law.*
